entries.e8039c805daf5171: A real estate company whose main business is planning, developing, and selling the "Crest" series of newly built condominiums for sale in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and which also operates rental, management, and hotel businesses.
entries.e99a91583245f851: In the Tokyo metropolitan area, it offers Crest series condominiums, mainly family-type, such as “Crest City” and “Crest Residence”. With a commitment to high-grade condominiums, it is involved in each stage of design and construction through dedicated departments to thoroughly manage quality, and provides total services from planning and sales through after-sales follow-up. Amid intensifying competition for land acquisition and rising construction costs, its challenge is to concentrate management resources in central Tokyo and areas near the city center, where strong demand is expected, and to improve its procurement competitiveness, product development capabilities and sales capabilities.
